subject: The secret setting 95% of users never discover
preview_text: This one tweak in PupShape can double your dog's weight loss results. Most owners miss it completely.
body_paragraphs: I watched a golden retriever named Buddy transform from sluggish to sprinting in 6 weeks. His owner did everything right—measured meals, regular walks, the works. But the real game-changer? A single toggle buried in settings that 19 out of 20 users scroll right past.

Here's the truth: dogs don't lose weight at a steady pace. Their metabolism adjusts as they shed pounds, which means the perfect calorie target at week 1 becomes overfeeding by week 4. Most apps (and owners) miss this. They stick with the same plan and wonder why progress stalls after the first few pounds. That's where the 'Adaptive Calorie Mode' comes in—it automatically recalculates your dog's needs every 7 days based on actual weight loss, not just estimates.

Open PupShape, tap the gear icon in the top right, scroll to 'Nutrition Settings,' and flip on 'Adaptive Calorie Mode.' It takes 10 seconds. The app will now adjust your meal plans weekly, preventing plateaus and keeping your dog's metabolism guessing (in a good way). This is what separates the 5% who hit their target weight from those who give up halfway.

Turn on Adaptive Mode now—it works retroactively on all your logged data. Your next week's meal plan will already be smarter. P.S. The dogs who use this feature reach their goal weight 37% faster. I should've made it more obvious from day one.
